projects.title: LiXr
projects.description:
LiXr is an internal tool that helps us manage our experimentation platform in an easier way (Lix). With LiXr, our developers can simulate a specific user's setting and test different functionality across the site with a simple click. It was built using DustJS, jQuery, Grunt and mongoDB. 

Read more about LinkedIn's experimentation platform at http://engineering.linkedin.com/testing/quality-control-linkedins-testing-methodology
